title: Triple-redundant aircraft avionics
goal: Show majority-voted triple-redundant flight computers in a series avionics path.

rubric.must: A left-to-right reliability path visibly represents aircraft avionics success path.
The drawing visibly shows three flight-control computers in a visibly labelled 2/3 group.
The drawing visibly shows power distribution and actuator interface as series blocks.
Every component block visibly displays its reliability value.
Input and output terminals visibly bracket the success path.
A computed system-reliability summary is visible on the drawing.

ideal.notes: Updated 2026-09-14 against exemplar visual-eval/exemplars/rbd/ideal.svg (sha256 1f4f1225b103). Exemplar pale block fills and blue numerical emphasis. Voting groups and reliability values retained. Visually inspected at full size and across the case family; independent targets, not engine-output snapshots.
